note: Live roster of individual AI agent SESSIONS/instances — not to be confused with registry/AI_REGISTRY.json (a static directory of known agent TYPES/vendors). This file answers 'who is doing what right now', not just 'what kinds of AI exist'. One entry per running/recent session. A session must upsert its own entry (by agent_id) on start, update last_seen while working, and set status honestly on every pause/stop. File-level locking itself lives in registry/LOCK_MANAGER.json — this file is identity/liveness, not locking.

status_enum.idle: session open, not actively editing (e.g. between turns, waiting on something that isn't the user)
status_enum.blocked: paused specifically waiting on a human decision (see registry/CURRENT_STATE.json open_questions)
status_enum.token_exhausted: session ended because it ran out of context/tokens, not because the task was done
status_enum.submitted: session finished its assigned work and hands off cleanly (see registry/HANDOFF.json)
status_enum.unknown: no verified signal for this session's current state — must be labeled unknown, never guessed
